text:
Complete the quest Children of the Sun. Log in as "tutor1" (password "tutor1pass").

Every game action must go through `mcp__mors__execute_code` (TypeScript with `sdk` in scope); use `get_state` and `screenshot` to look. Read `playing/CLAUDE.md` and `playing/tutor1/CLAUDE.md` first.
Quest progress is varbit 9632: `(await sdk.client.act("varbit", {id: 9632})).value` (0 = not started, 24 = complete). You are done when it is complete. Take a screenshot at the end and report.

Rules: play like a normal player on the real game. Only use normal game actions (walk, click NPCs/objects/items/widgets, dialogue keys, camera). Do NOT type "::" server commands or teleport; they are disabled and count as cheating. Learn the way a player would, from the game and the OSRS wiki: don't read the game server's source code or files (`../openrune`), and don't change any code. If something in the game looks broken, say exactly what and stop.
Before you stop, update `playing/tutor1/CLAUDE.md` and any lesson for every account in `playing/CLAUDE.md`.

text:
tutor1 has finished Children of the Sun. Varbit 9632 reads 24, and the final screenshot shows the "Congratulations! You have completed Children of the Sun!" scroll, which gives 1 quest point (3 in total now) and opens Varlamore.

1. **Getting there.** tutor1 logged in down in the Wizards' Tower basement. I climbed out and walked along the roads to Varrock square. On the tower's ground floor the pathfinder stayed stuck even with both doors open, so I got out with short single-tile walks.
2. **Starting the quest.** I talked to Alina and Noah, said "Yes.", then asked "When will this delegation arrive?". After the delegation scene, a guard walks off with a suspicious bag.
3. **Tailing the guard.** This took about eight tries. I was spotted twice, and lost him when I fell more than about 15 tiles behind. The game doesn't tell my code which way an NPC is facing, so I logged where he stopped (he turns around at each stop) and mapped the walls around his route. His stops are near the square, then 3242,3404, then 3236,3390, then 3248,3390, then 3254,3396. What worked was to move the moment he left each stop:
   - wait inside Lowe's Archery Emporium;
   - move to the north wall of the building south of it;
   - move to that building's south-east corner;
   - get into Old Man Yarlo's house. The wiki's west-wall stop wasn't needed, and the house can only be entered from its east side.

   The bandits' meeting then played as a cutscene.
4. **Marking the bandits.** At this camera zoom I could only confirm one guard by eye: the one outside Lowe's with no weapon and arms crossed. I marked the other three by matching their spots to the wiki's descriptions: outside Aris's tent, the woman guard by Benny's stand, and the one further along the east path. All four marks were correct the first time, and Sergeant Tobyn had them arrested.
5. **Finishing.** On the palace roof I talked to Tobyn and then Prince Itzla while he interrogated a bandit, and the quest completed.

I only used normal game actions: no server commands, no teleports, no code changes.
